text.description_html:
Omnia 3919-US32D, Modern Square Stainless Steel Fingertip Edge Pull

Made by Omnia, the Square Brushed Stainless Steel Fingertip Edge Pull is most often used on sliding pocket doors where it is pressure mounted into the door's edge so that you have something to grip in order to slide the door out of the pocket. The brushed stainless steel finish along with the square shape adds a modern touch, making this finishing detail a great match for you contemporary tastes!

Specifications for the Square Small Edge Door Pulls:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Length: 1-1/8" square
  • Finger Cutout Diameter: 3/4"
  • Door Cutout Length: 13/16"
  • Door Cutout Diameter: 31/32"
  • Projection: 1/16" (2 mm)

Sold Individually
